PRESETS.name: Alphabet
PRESETS.summary: The strongest business in this group. Held back mainly by regulators and a huge AI spending bill.

val.note: Reported EPS of $19.93 is inflated by about $136B of one-time gains on equity stakes, so fair value uses normal operating earnings.

parts: 34% operating margin and $242B cash, but AI spending made Q2 free cash flow negative (-$5.9B) and buybacks were paused.
Reported P/E looks like 17, but one-time gains inflate earnings; on normal earnings it is about 25x, still below Microsoft and Meta.
Search, YouTube, Android and Cloud plus its own AI chips and models. Threats are regulators and an AI overbuild.
Designs its own TPU chips, but still relies on Taiwan chip plants, memory and electricity; management says it is supply-constrained.
AI computing demand is bigger than Google can build. Cloud backlog reached $514B.
Cloud quarterly revenue went from $13.6B to $24.8B in one year; 12 straight quarters of double-digit growth.
Chatbots threaten classic search, yet Search revenue still grew 17%; nearly 90% of the Fortune 100 use Gemini Enterprise.
Lost its final appeal on a 4.1B euro EU fine; fighting EU orders to open Android to rival AI by 2027; US DOJ cases still open.
Ad budgets shrink in recessions, but multi-year Cloud contracts cushion the hit.
56 of 61 analysts rate it Buy, none Sell. Investors online worry about the $195-205B 2026 spending plan.

s: Search, YouTube, Android and Cloud under one roof
w: Share dilution from the $80B stock raise
About 79% of revenue still from Google Services
o: $514B Cloud backlog, about half due within 24 months
Selling TPU systems to outside data centers
t: Chatbots pulling queries away from Google

bull: Cloud keeps growing 50%+ and free cash flow turns positive again in 2027.
base: Revenue grows high teens, spending stays heavy, stock tracks analyst targets.
bear: AI demand slows while 2027 spending rises, or a court orders a structural remedy.

catalysts: EU order to share search data with rivals takes effect
EU deadline to open Android to rival AI assistants
PRESETS.sentiment: Wall Street is strongly positive, with a consensus target near $422. Online investors are split on whether the AI spending will pay back in time.
sources: Capex raise and negative cash flow (Yahoo Finance)

Runners and younger buyers moving to Hoka, On and others; Jordan sales fell from $8.7B to $7.0B in two years.
China sales down eight straight quarters (-12% last quarter); US tariffs on Asian imports.
$100+ sneakers are an easy purchase to delay when money is tight.
Consensus is Hold; Baird, Stifel and JPMorgan cut ratings or targets in September. A few contrarians call it a bottom.

o: CEO Elliott Hill's reset toward running and retail partners
t: Hoka, On and Adidas taking share

sources: Shift to making silicon (24/7 Wall St.)

PRESETS.name: Intel
PRESETS.summary: Intel has more than tripled in 2026 on AI demand and Apple foundry deal buzz, but it still lost $11B over the past year.

val.note: 35x for a recovery story; the price already exceeds the analyst target.

parts: Turnaround with real momentum, real risks.
Owns US factories, a strategic plus.
Still far below its old profitability.
US government backing; China sales exposure.
Buy consensus, but the target is below the price.
PRESETS.sentiment: A hot turnaround trade; many worry the run got ahead of results.
sources: Tripled on Apple deal buzz (Startup Fortune)

PRESETS.name: Vertiv
PRESETS.summary: Vertiv cools and powers AI data centers; its backlog is about $15B and the stock is up 64% in a year.

val.note: 32x for 25% growth tied to AI construction.

parts: Leader in liquid cooling for AI.
Factories and parts sourcing are stretched.
Every AI data center needs cooling.
Data-center building slows if AI spending drops.
Strong Buy consensus with a $338 target.
PRESETS.sentiment: A favorite AI infrastructure pick.

PRESETS.name: GE Vernova
PRESETS.summary: GE Vernova's backlog hit about $176B as AI and grid demand pushed gas-turbine orders to 116 GW.

val.note: Trailing EPS includes one-time gains; 40x on forward EPS for 30% growth.

parts: $12.4B free cash flow; thin operating margin.
Sold-out gas turbines and grid gear.
Turbine factory capacity is the bottleneck.
Became a powerhouse after the GE split.
Utilities and data centers need power.
PRESETS.sentiment: Very popular power-demand play.

PRESETS.name: IonQ
PRESETS.summary: IonQ is growing revenue fast from a small base but lost $1.4B last year; the stock is down 28% in a year.

val.note: No earnings, so this uses 3x book value. It is a bet on future quantum computers.

parts: Revenue rising from a small base.
Customers are mostly governments and labs.
Strong Buy consensus, weak price trend.
PRESETS.sentiment: Hype-driven and volatile.
sources: Down 43% in a year (24/7 Wall St.)

PRESETS.name: Rocket Lab
PRESETS.summary: Rocket Lab is a growing space company still losing money; its larger Neutron rocket has yet to launch.

val.note: No earnings, so this uses estimated revenue per share times 25. Speculative.

PRESETS.sentiment: Retail favorite; Neutron timing is the debate.

PRESETS.name: Shopify
PRESETS.summary: Shopify grew revenue 34% and merchant sales 32% last quarter, helped by AI shopping traffic.

val.note: 55x for 30% growth.

parts: AI shopping agents send more orders.
PRESETS.sentiment: Growth investors like it; price is the issue.

PRESETS.name: ServiceNow
PRESETS.summary: ServiceNow fell hard on fears AI will replace software seats, though its AI revenue passed $1B.

val.note: 32x for 20% growth; down from its old premium.

parts: AI deals now half of new business.
AI agents could reduce seat counts.
Strong Buy consensus, poor stock momentum.
PRESETS.sentiment: Fear of AI disruption dominates; contrarians see value.

PRESETS.name: Salesforce
PRESETS.summary: Salesforce trades at about 16x forward earnings as investors doubt it can grow in the AI era, though Agentforce passed $1B in annual revenue.

val.note: 18x for 10% growth and strong cash flow.

PRESETS.sentiment: Seen as cheap but stuck.

PRESETS.name: Visa
PRESETS.summary: Visa topped estimates and raised guidance as payments volume passed $4T a quarter; stablecoin settlement grew 15x.

val.note: 27x is Visa's typical premium.

parts: Card and digital payments keep rising.
PRESETS.sentiment: A steady compounder investors trust.

PRESETS.name: Berkshire Hathaway
PRESETS.summary: Under new CEO Greg Abel, Berkshire has started spending its huge cash pile, including $4.5B of buybacks last quarter.

val.note: Berkshire is valued on book value; 1.6x is near its long-run range.

PRESETS.sentiment: Trusted, but investors watch the new CEO.

PRESETS.name: ExxonMobil
PRESETS.summary: Exxon is up about 45% in a year as oil climbed above $100 and LNG growth improved the outlook.

val.note: 13x on high oil-price earnings; 20% margin because oil can fall fast.

PRESETS.sentiment: Popular hedge against the oil shock.

PRESETS.name: Coca-Cola
PRESETS.summary: Coca-Cola is up about 30% in 2026, beating every Magnificent Seven stock, on volume growth and raised guidance.

val.note: 23x is Coca-Cola's typical premium.

parts: Local bottlers; sugar and aluminum costs.
PRESETS.sentiment: A safe-haven favorite this year.

PRESETS.name: Disney
PRESETS.summary: Disney is down about 12% in a year under new CEO Josh D'Amaro and trades at about 14x forward earnings.

val.note: 16x for steady low-double-digit growth.

parts: Solid profits and $8.3B free cash flow.
Viewers moving from TV to streaming.
Parks and travel suffer in recessions.
PRESETS.sentiment: Seen as cheap; investors want proof from the new CEO.

PRESETS.name: Home Depot
PRESETS.summary: Home Depot has fallen about 31% in a year as a frozen housing market hurts sales; the dividend yield is now 3.4%.

val.note: 21x is below its usual mid-20s while housing is weak.

parts: Pros and DIY customers both cautious.
PRESETS.sentiment: Called a falling knife by some, a dividend bargain by others.
sources: Is the dividend safe? (24/7 Wall St.)

PRESETS.name: Coupang
PRESETS.summary: Coupang is down about 57% in a year after a data-breach fine, an SEC complaint and slowing growth in Korea.

val.note: Earnings are depressed, so this uses 1x sales; 25% margin for regulatory risk.

parts: Losses; free cash flow near zero.
Forward P/E about 89 on depressed earnings.
PRESETS.sentiment: Very negative after the breach fallout.

PRESETS.name: PayPal
PRESETS.summary: PayPal trades under 10x earnings while a new CEO works on a turnaround that may stretch to 2028.

val.note: 12x for a slow-growth turnaround.

parts: Shoppers moving to Apple Pay and others.
PRESETS.sentiment: Cheap but distrusted.

PRESETS.name: Boeing
PRESETS.summary: Boeing is ramping 737 output toward 47 a month, but it still loses money on operations and cash-flow targets keep slipping.

val.note: Earnings are depressed, so this uses estimated 2027 free cash flow per share.

PRESETS.sentiment: Analysts like the recovery story; investors are tired of delays.
sources: Cash flow target delayed (24/7 Wall St.)
